caption: A floating-point argument evaluates directly to a decimal
m greater than 1, via the reciprocal-modulus transformation
Symbolic arguments are left unevaluated rather than guessed at

u = 10^16 has no argument reduction against the real period 4K(m) before the AGM kernel runs: u itself, not u mod 4K(m), goes into agmAmplitudeReal, so every digit is lost to rounding long before the trig factors (mpmath ellipfun, dps=30, agrees to 20 digits; not yet implemented here).
